svg.title: Rota da Livraria
svg.desc: Ilustração original do desafio Rota da Livraria.
svg.metadata: {"generator": "image_gen built-in", "prompt": "Use case: illustration-story. Use the attached artwork ONLY as a STYLE and CHARACTER REFERENCE: reproduce its polished detailed pixel-art rendering, crisp small pixels, beautiful dimensional lighting, cozy Brazilian indie adventure atmosphere and the SAME Black teenage heroine with dark brown skin, voluminous short curly afro hair, lavender purple jacket, cream shirt, navy trousers and white-soled sneakers. Create ONE entirely new finished game-selection cover for another VOICES challenge, replacing the whole scene and pose. Wide landscape 20:9 aspect ratio (approximately 1870x841), edge-to-edge artwork for a 640x288 card. Professional rich 16-bit pixel-art key art with readable silhouettes, nuanced dithering, layered scenery and strong focal hierarchy, not generic chunky rectangles. NO text, lettering, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, HUD, borders, screenshots, photorealism or smooth vector art. All key action should stay within the central 75 percent height for panoramic composition. Challenge: Rota da Livraria. A lively delivery adventure on a warmly lit neighborhood square. Show the heroine in three-quarter view hurrying toward the right with a small neatly wrapped book parcel tucked securely in both arms. Behind her on the left is an inviting teal bookshop with an arched open doorway, richly detailed bookshelves visible in the window, terracotta roof and leafy flowering vines. On the right is a small neighborhood school with broad steps; a friendly dark-skinned young recipient waits to accept a delivery. A curving cobblestone path clearly connects bookshop and recipient. Include one small handcart stacked with books and parcels, a bench, potted plants and charming town facades. Afternoon golden sun, sage green, teal and cream architecture, orange terracotta and amber accents. Communicate book delivery and exploration at thumbnail size. No portals and no runners' lane markings."}
